headline: Hardik Dhimantbhai Gandhi resigns as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of Rolex Rings
hook: Key compliance officer exits Rolex Rings
summary: Rolex Rings Limited has announced that Hardik Dhimantbhai Gandhi is stepping down from his role as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. His resignation becomes effective on October 7, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance change involving senior management personnel at the listed auto component maker. Indian retail investors should note this managerial transition as part of regular company filings.
whats_next: Appointment of a new compliance officer
why_it_matters: Routine management change with no immediate financial impact

headline: InCred issues Buy rating on Rolex Rings with a target price of INR 251
hook: Brokerage targets 32 percent upside on Rolex Rings
summary: InCred has initiated coverage on Rolex Rings with a Buy rating, citing strong potential growth up to FY28. The brokerage forecasts a 28% to 32% price upside driven by recovering US exports and rising European demand. Rolex Rings shares have delivered 66% returns over the past six months. Indian retail investors tracking auto-ancillary stocks should evaluate export-driven growth trends in bearing rings.
why_it_matters: Analyst targets export recovery for auto-ancillary holdings
winners_losers: Rolex Rings shareholders gain / none hurt
